# Implementation

## Changed behavior

- `src/index.ts` now exports four factories:
  - `createReservationService({ storage })` for the unchanged legacy storage contract.
  - `createStockReport({ source })` for `lowStock` reports using only `source.readSnapshot()`.
  - `createObservationReceiver({ sink })` for inventory observations using only `sink.appendObservation(event)`.
  - `createProviderBReservationService({ storage })` for the Provider B `read` and `commitBatch` contract.
- `createStockReport` validates `{ op: "lowStock", belowUnits }` before I/O, rejects malformed snapshots and duplicate SKUs as `500 storage_unavailable`, computes `availableUnits`, filters strictly below the threshold, and sorts returned items by JavaScript string comparison.
- `createObservationReceiver` validates `{ op: "recordObservation", observationId, sku, observedUnits }` before I/O, appends exactly the documented observation event fields, accepts unknown SKUs, maps `"stored"` to `201`, maps `"duplicate"` to `200`, and maps rejected or unknown sink outcomes to `500 storage_unavailable`.
- `createProviderBReservationService` preserves the legacy reservation API responses while translating Provider B envelopes and decimal-string rows. It maps `NO_SUCH_KEY` to missing records, maps temporary/malformed lookup outcomes to `500`, writes one atomic batch for new reservations, maps `"revision_conflict"` to `409 commit_conflict`, and treats unknown batch outcomes as `500`.

## Affected call paths

- Legacy reservation behavior remains in `src/reservation.ts`.
- Shared public host and record types were extended in `src/types.ts`.
- Shared boundary helpers in `src/validation.ts` now include canonical decimal-string decoding and encoding for Provider B.
- Report handling is isolated in `src/report.ts`.
- Observation handling is isolated in `src/observation.ts`.
- Provider B reservation handling is isolated in `src/providerB.ts`.

## Deviations and limitations

- No runtime validation package was added because dependencies are fixed and no validation library is installed. Boundary validation is implemented with explicit local predicates.
- `bun run typecheck` failed in this workspace before invoking the project script with `CouldntReadCurrentDirectory`. Direct execution of the installed compiler succeeded with the same `--noEmit` check, and `bun test` ran successfully.

## Validation performed

- `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` passed.
- `bun test src/integration.test.ts` passed.
- Added focused tests for report sorting/validation, observation payload and duplicate mapping, Provider B reservation batch shape/idempotency/error mapping, and legacy invalid-command no-I/O behavior.

external_semantics_sources.rule: Assertion::$ requires end of input when Multiline is false. The decimal regular expression at validation.ts:30 has no flags, so trailing line terminators are rejected.

supplementalAssessment.overall_assessment: The full source and actual changes support all thirteen requirements and the primary no-finding result. Separate Provider B code preserves legacy behavior without provisioning extra dependencies. Boundary review included malformed success envelopes, wrong lookup keys, zero versus positive quantity bounds, revision exhaustion and one-event batch construction. No necessary correction was established.
uncertainties: Static source audit only; no implementation, test or typecheck execution.
